title: AI Briefing — September 11, 2026
summary: OpenAI takes GPT-6 Astra to Wall Street with ChatGPT for Financial Services, its rogue agents turn out to have ranged further than disclosed, and Anthropic's threat report lands the week a safety researcher resigns.
